public_body: Great Barrington Housing Authority Board Of Commissioners
overall: The AG found one Open Meeting Law violation: a board member's forwarding of a substantive email to a quorum of the board was deliberation outside a posted meeting. The other challenged emails were not deliberation. No intent finding or order was issued; only a caution about future civil penalties.

allegations.summary: A board member allegedly deliberated outside a posted meeting by forwarding an email containing her concerns about housing authority payments to the whole board.
allegations.key_passage: We find that Ms. Mooney’s February 11 email, forwarding her February 8 email, constituted deliberation outside of a posted meeting, in violation of the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Emails from a board member to the chair suggesting agenda topics were alleged to be deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board emails we reviewed in which Ms. Mooney emailed the Board’s Chair with suggested agenda topics are not deliberations under the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Emails among board members about registering for a virtual conference were alleged to be deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Any emails relating to Board members’ registrations for a virtual conference are also not deliberation, as they contain mere scheduling and procedural information.

allegations.summary: A board member's April 2021 question to the executive director, copied to the whole board, was alleged to be deliberation outside a posted meeting.
allegations.key_passage: We find that this email containing a question to the Executive Director in response to information the Executive Director had distributed was not improper deliberation because the email was administrative in nature and Ms. Mooney did not express an opinion in the email.

allegations.summary: A board member's reply-all email asking another member not to reply to all on an invoice thread was alleged to be improper deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Because we do not find a violation of the Open Meeting Law where a public body member attempts to warn other public body members against violating the Open Meeting Law, we do not find that Ms. Ryan’s email violated the Open Meeting Law.
